decision.reason: [ev-7e86af7082a3] is just a single list item ("- workload") under the `service_name` label heading in the upgrade guide. It leaves out the surrounding list and the sentence that introduces it. Without that context, the excerpt does not say what "workload" refers to (a label or attribute name?) or what changed (added, removed, or a lookup order?). It also does not say which environments are affected or what happens if operators do nothing. Both proposals reached the same conclusion. The surrounding lines of the `service_name` section are needed, and this item is probably part of a larger change rather than a change by itself.
